source: Author requested fashionable fancy husk-fiber textile clothing, October 16, 2026. Existing Elaborate husk-fiber wear is refined into one coat. Docs/WORLD_BASIS.md establishes difficult husk-fiber textile preparation and very rare, expensive elaborate fashion; no ordinary cloth or wood assumed.
scope: Five independently listed fancy husk-fiber garments: reuse the broad garment ID for a coat and add four pieces. No full-set inventory item, set bonus, faction dress code, new equipment slots, runtime world identity, streaming or saved-game changes.

defaults.Carrier metadata: Booter-worn fashion garment; fitting, packing and canister clearance unresolved.
defaults.Acquisition: Proposed specialist fashion craft or high-value trade. Elaborate fashion is very rare and expensive; exact availability, cost and maker remain unresolved.
defaults.Crafting / processing: Candidate shaping and assembly of extensively prepared husk-fiber textile panels, fine strip bindings and small metal fittings. Very large material inputs and crafting effort are intended; quantities, yields, recipes and times remain undefined. Raw husk abundance does not make textile manufacture easy.
defaults.Limitations: Fashion clothing, not armor. Material preparation, seams, fit, comfort, wear and performance remain proposals. No ordinary cloth, wood, free-water textile process, social-stat bonus, set bonus or equipment slot introduced.
defaults.Classification basis: One separate fashionable husk-fiber garment; family membership adds no counted outfit. Rarity and value follow the author's elaborate-fashion direction without assigning prices.
defaults.Tier basis: Proposed T3 finished fashion piece assembled from qualified T2 husk-fiber textile inputs and supporting fittings. Exact preparation and construction remain unresolved; rarity is separate from tier.

items.name: Pleated husk-fiber dress coat
items.purpose: One fitted fashion coat with a high folded collar, long split tails and narrow fan pleats at the back. Burnished metal clasps and layered husk-fiber edges give the proposed family a sculpted formal silhouette. Reuses the former broad Elaborate husk-fiber wear entry as one coat.
items.icon: One elegant rust-and-ochre husk-fiber dress coat with a folded high collar, long split tails, fan-pleated back and small burnished metal clasps. Visible pressed fiber texture; no ordinary woven cloth, wearer or complete outfit.

fields.Search aliases: elaborate husk-fiber wear; fancy husk fiber set; fashionable textile; formal coat; separate garment
fields.Open design decisions: Panel preparation, fold retention, joining, collar fit, closure and canister clearance require design. No uniform, rank, social privilege or armor benefit established.

items.name: Panelled husk-fiber dress trousers
items.purpose: One pair of tailored fashion trousers with long narrow pressed panels, a folded waistband and layered side edging. Designed to continue the coat's vertical lines while remaining a separate garment.
items.icon: Only a pair of elegant ochre husk-fiber trousers with narrow vertical panel seams, folded waistband, layered edge trim and small metal closures. No footwear, wearer or full outfit.

fields.Search aliases: fancy husk fiber set; fashionable textile; formal trousers; panelled legwear; separate garment
fields.Open design decisions: Hip and knee movement, panel joining, fastening, fit and crease retention remain unresolved. No movement or social-stat bonus assigned.

items.name: Folded husk-fiber court shoes
items.purpose: One matched pair of decorative closed shoes with folded husk-fiber uppers, layered prepared-fiber soles and a small metal instep clasp. Court is a proposed style label, not an established institution or dress code.
items.icon: Only a matched pair of low elegant husk-fiber shoes with folded uppers, layered soles, squared toes and small burnished instep clasps. No wearer, trousers or full outfit.

fields.Search aliases: fancy husk fiber set; fashionable textile; formal shoes; dress footwear; separate garment
fields.Open design decisions: Sole construction, grip, fit, edge finishing, clasp strength and wear remain design work. No terrain protection or accepted court tradition established.

items.name: Layered-cuff husk-fiber dress gloves
items.purpose: One matched pair of close-fitting fashion gloves with short layered fan cuffs and tiny metal wrist closures. They echo the coat's pleats without including sleeves or claiming protective performance.
items.icon: Only a matched pair of fine husk-fiber dress gloves with short fan-fold cuffs and tiny metal wrist closures. Visible prepared fiber texture, no wearer, tool, coat or complete outfit.

fields.Open design decisions: Finger articulation, joining, fastening, fit and useful wear life remain unresolved. No electrical, thermal or combat protection established.

items.name: Fan-fold husk-fiber headdress
items.purpose: One elaborate headpiece with a low fitted crown and an offset fan of folded husk-fiber panels held by a narrow metal comb. A proposed fashion silhouette independent of any faith, faction, rank or ceremonial obligation.
items.icon: One elegant low-crown husk-fiber headdress with an asymmetric fan of ochre folded panels and a narrow burnished metal comb. No feathers, ordinary cloth, wearer or full outfit.
